description: bits-ui's Separator compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified separator wrapper and its demos (separator-demo: horizontal between text blocks; separator-vertical: three vertical separators in a row of links). A third separator takes its orientation and decorative props from the app through the wrapper's rest props (a boolean reaching a declared prop of the bits-ui component through a spread): role separator or none, aria-orientation, aria-hidden, data-orientation and the data-horizontal/data-vertical utilities, and a class merged by cn over the wrapper's (bg-primary replacing bg-border)
